interface.name: lumen_toplevel_identity_manager_v1

description.summary: optional identity bridge for an existing foreign handle

interface.description: This project-owned protocol links a live wlr foreign toplevel handle to its compositor's existing ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier. It grants no actuation authority. An unavailable bridge must preserve existing foreign-toplevel behavior. All objects belong to one Wayland connection.

request.name: resolve

description.summary: resolve an exact live resource without heuristic joins

request.description: handle must be a non-null zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 resource on this connection. A valid but inert, closed, or unsupported resource returns unavailable. A malformed wire object ID or null argument may cause a core protocol error before this request is dispatched. The reply is one-shot and independent of the manager lifetime.

interface.name: lumen_toplevel_identity_reply_v1
interface.description: The server immediately snapshots the requested live resource membership and sends exactly one result, destroying this server resource. A client may locally destroy its proxy before the result to abandon observation; there is no cancellation request racing the terminal result.

arg.name: identifier
arg.summary: existing ext identifier, or empty when unavailable
